title: RingCentral Pricing 2026: Plans, Fees & Add-Ons
summary: RingCentral pricing varies by plan, from basic to enterprise options. See what each tier costs and how they compare to competitors for your business needs.
body_markdown:
## Frequently asked questions


### Does RingCentral offer a free trial?


Usually yes, but the terms depend on the plan and the region, so read the trial terms on the plan page you are buying from.


Check whether a card is required up front and what happens at the end of the trial. If it converts to a paid term automatically, the trial is the first day of a billing commitment.


Is RingCentral cheaper if you pay annually? Yes, the per-user price shown with annual billing is lower than the monthly price on the same pricing page. That discount is payment for commitment.


Run it as a simple comparison: the annual saving against the cost of being locked in if your headcount drops or you outgrow the tier.


Does RingCentral charge for international calls? Yes, beyond whatever calling regions your plan includes. Included calling covers a defined set of destinations, and everything outside it is billed by destination.


Look up the countries your team actually dials on RingCentral's international rates page before assuming the plan covers them. Don't infer it from the headline price.


### Can you cancel RingCentral mid-contract?


You can ask, but a term agreement generally means you owe for the term you signed.


The pricing page does not control this; the order form and the terms of service do. If you may change headcount or vendors, the monthly rate costs more per seat but gives you a clean exit.


Get any exception in writing rather than from a sales call.


Is there a minimum number of users? Some tiers or products may set a floor, since per-user pricing implies a seat count. The pricing page for each tier is the place to confirm this.


It matters most for very small teams, because a floor turns a cheap-looking per-user price into a larger fixed monthly cost than the arithmetic suggests.
